comments.author: jero

For anyone having issues and needing to re-enable settings through the BepInEx menu (F12): I just released version 1.0.1. I added some extra checks and also some diagnostic logs to help with troubleshooting. You can check the log at:

[SPT Folder]/BepInEx/LogOutput.log

Search for the term “VisorEffectManager” and please report it by opening an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/silviohmartins/VisorEffectManager/issues

comments.author: PenOkOh
comments.body_html:
A hotkey sounds like the best option ngl, you know, because there will always be those that prefer the arcade approach in dealing with mask filters. I myself prefer realism, but for the sake of seeing something, I’d rather turn it off. It’s enough that the world is punishing, why make it even more by removing 70% of the screen.

Additionally if you’re up for it, perhaps make a folder including all masks filters as in the pngs or jpgs and give people an option to customise them. I can see myself have a slight blackness around the border of the screen, so it still feels like you’re cramped into a heavy duty helmet. I know other mods that includes custom masks or nvgs have the same thing. I used to edit Borkel’s nvgs because I very much don’t want circles on the screen.
